source.statement: With high probability, for query access to A and b, row sparsity r<=n, and epsilon>0, output x with ||Ax-b||_2^2 <= (1+epsilon) min_y ||Ay-b||_2^2 in O~(r sqrt(mn)/epsilon + n^3) time.

full_credit_condition: A machine-checkable proof certificate for the universal algorithm/runtime guarantee, an executable implementation of the named quantum subroutines with independently calibrated resource scaling, or a valid assumption-satisfying counterexample.
result: Four distinct routes found neither a proof certificate nor a valid counterexample. Finite sampling simulations are scoped corroboration only.
